about_the_game:
Grow your spaceship from hundreds of unique synergistic items and then take it to battle against other players.

Choose Your Captain

Each captain brings their own unique strengths and weaknesses to the battlefield. New, thematic items will be added to the shop depending on your class selection. Combine different factions together to exploit the best of what they have to offer.

Roll The Shop

The shop is brimming with hundreds of unique items from across the galaxy. Roll the shop to find the items that work best with your build. But remember, rarer is not always better. Even common items can be leveraged to create powerful, game-breaking combos.

Optimize Your Build

Rearrange your items to find the best layout possible. Create a balanced design, or go all-in on a single plan of attack.

Let The Battle Unfold

Your ship will automatically battle against your opponent, using the layout that you configure in the shop. So place every item with care.

Crunch The Numbers

Detailed tooltips, graphs, and combat logs help you make the right decisions about your ship. Dive into the complexity, or turn a blind a eye... it's up to you.

Features:

  • 9 starting captains with unique abilities and layouts.

  • 200+ unique items to draft from.

  • Versus Mode: Battle against spaceships created by other players. Get to 10 wins before running out of lives. Climb the leaderboard in ranked mode, or go at you own pace in casual play, testing builds and chasing after ridiculous combos. If you still are not satisfied after reaching 10 wins, continue on in endless mode, growing your ship to absurd strength.

  • Campaign Mode: Venture out into deep space, fighting through waves of increasingly difficult campaign enemies. After you've beaten a campaign, you'll unlock the next ascension. With each ascension, new, powerful modifiers are added that make the enemies more terrifying than before.

  • Bounty Mode: Hunt wanted pirates and claim their bounties! Undefeated builds created by other players are posted on the bounty map. If you defeat them in battle, you take their spot on the map, earning gold from every players that challenges your ship.

  • Sandbox Mode: Free build fantastical ships, or craft custom campaigns that can be shared with your friends and the community at large.

short_description: A strategic auto battler that blends detailed inventory management with a chaotic sci-fi universe. Climb the ranks by battling against other players, or fly solo against challenging campaigns full of corrupting aliens and pillaging pirates.
